    • getResponseBody

      public reactor.core.publisher.Flux<T> getResponseBody()
      Return the response body as a Flux<T> of decoded elements.

      响应体流随后可以使用 "reactor-test" 的 `StepVerifier` 进行进一步消费，并在从（可能是无限的）流中消费了足够多的元素后取消：

      FluxExchangeResult<Person> result = this.client.get()
        .uri("/persons")
        .accept(TEXT_EVENT_STREAM)
        .exchange()
        .expectStatus().isOk()
        .expectHeader().contentType(TEXT_EVENT_STREAM)
        .expectBody(Person.class)
        .returnResult();

StepVerifier.create(result.getResponseBody())
        .expectNext(new Person("Jane"), new Person("Jason"))
        .expectNextCount(4)
        .expectNext(new Person("Jay"))
        .thenCancel()
        .verify();

    • consumeWith

      public void consumeWith(Consumer<FluxExchangeResult<T>> consumer)
      在 `ExchangeResult.assertWithDiagnostics(Runnable)` 中调用给定的消费者，并将 "this" 实例传递给它。此方法允许在不离开 WebTestClient 调用链的情况下执行以下操作： 
      client.get()
                .uri("/persons")
                .accept(TEXT_EVENT_STREAM)
                .exchange()
                .expectStatus().isOk()
        .returnResult()
        .consumeWith(result -> assertThat(...);
      Parameters:
      consumer - 用于"this"实例的消费者
